newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish GDP growth fell to 2.4 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Danish GDP growth fell to 2.4 pct in 1996.

text.p: Denmark's GDP growth rate fell to 2.4 percent in 1996 compared to 2.6 per cent in the previous year, but rose 3.3 percent in the fourth quarter from the same 1995 period, the national statistics office said on Wednesday.
The office also reported a 0.4 percent seasonally adjusted rise in the growth rate in the fourth quarter of 1996 from the third quarter.

Economists polled by Reuters had on average forecast 0.5 percent rise in GDP growth in 1996's fourth quarter from the same year's third quarter, with the fourth quarter 3.1 percent up on the same 1995 period. They had predicted a rise for whole year 1996 of 2.3 percent.
